name: TNT (2,4,6-trinitrotoluene), monoclinic, Z = 8
force_field: non-reactive TNT force field with full topology: buck + lj/cut + coul/wolf, 11 A cutoff (in.tnt-run0.lmp, in the private chain)
forcefield_note: a TNT-specific non-reactive force field (validated for TNT in the chain's examples).
setting_note: Miller indices are relative to the data-file a, b, c (a along x, b along y, c in xz; beta 110.4 deg). spglib reports P2_1/c (No. 14); in THIS setting the glide is a (h0l absent for h odd), i.e. P2_1/a. Literature (hkl) in P2_1/c (a and c swapped, beta ~110) or in the orthorhombic polymorph (Pca2_1) do NOT apply directly: convert by matching lattice parameters first.
spacegroup_data_setting: P2_1/a (No. 14; spglib prints the standard symbol P2_1/c)
source_structure: TNT unit cell of the private chain (CCDC-derived; not distributed here: the bundle keeps only gamma values, lattice parameters, hkl, costs and provenance ids/md5s)
